reviewers: Codex world and technology visual audit
method: Individually inspected every named row in native AppKit render sheets: the full initial 2x matrix and full post-correction 1x matrix, then rerendered and reinspected changed 2x rows. Badge-clearance refinements were reinspected at both scales. Retained artwork was verified byte-identical to the inspected snapshots. Verdicts are visual design assessments, not automated geometry-only approvals or human design certification.
